lessons.text: Assert pluralized count text at zero as well as at one and many; zero is where singular/plural bugs hide.

lessons.text: When a spec fixes an anchored regex, include a rejection sample that embeds a valid match inside invalid text.

lessons.text: A locale-collation requirement needs sample data whose order differs between code-point and locale comparison.

lessons.text: If a requirement names the message language, either assert a language marker or drop the language from the AC.

lessons.text: When a criterion places an element inside a region, name the container in the spec and scope the test locator to it

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::test exact match secrets with a case variant input not only a value differing in another character
lessons.text: Test exact-match secrets with a case-variant input, not only a value differing in another character

lessons.text: When the spec requires location.replace, assert history.length or back-navigation, not just the final URL

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::state the navigation method for user initiated navigations separately from automatic redirects
lessons.text: State the navigation method for user-initiated navigations separately from automatic redirects

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec says a page must not navigate by itself assert the url after a wait or record navigations not only at one instant
lessons.text: When a spec says a page must not navigate by itself, assert the URL after a wait or record navigations, not only at one instant

lessons.text: A fake clock only drives JS timers; to prove a page never navigates by itself, also assert no meta refresh exists or wait real time

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a criterion says any element of a kind assert it on at least two instances in different containers
lessons.text: When a criterion says any element of a kind, assert it on at least two instances in different containers.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec revision changes a domain definition re check documentation criteria against the new wording not only keyword presence
lessons.text: When a spec revision changes a domain definition, re-check documentation criteria against the new wording, not only keyword presence.

lessons.text: For a criterion that says a page shows an element, assert toBeVisible on every page in the list; toHaveText also passes on display:none.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert per item values with fixture data whose values differ per item uniform seed values hide which item a value came from
lessons.text: Assert per-item values with fixture data whose values differ per item; uniform seed values hide which item a value came from.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert stored state right after the operation under test before a later write can normalize it
lessons.text: Assert stored state right after the operation under test, before a later write can normalize it.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::test a data normalization edge case at the user visible surface too not only in the service that normalizes
lessons.text: Test a data-normalization edge case at the user-visible surface too, not only in the service that normalizes.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a new page joins a cross page criterion add it to the same parametrized test instead of a weaker separate check
lessons.text: When a new page joins a cross-page criterion, add it to the same parametrized test instead of a weaker separate check.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::keep implementation only constraints the ui cannot observe such as integer cent arithmetic in design not in acceptance criteria
lessons.text: Keep implementation-only constraints the UI cannot observe (such as integer-cent arithmetic) in design, not in acceptance criteria.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when asserting a server generated id make sure the id under test cannot equal a plausible constant such as 1 create a prior record first
lessons.text: When asserting a server-generated id, make sure the id under test cannot equal a plausible constant such as 1; create a prior record first.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a criterion lists several attributes of each shown item assert every attribute not only the item name
lessons.text: When a criterion lists several attributes of each shown item, assert every attribute, not only the item name.

lessons.text: Say whether an emptied storage key is removed or holds an empty value; empty is ambiguous.
